challenge.scenario: A disabled support employee is assigned to customer Office thread.
challenge.finding: Missing trigger permits support ticket exposure to deactivated member.
challenge.resolution: Preserve both private.office_active_store_member_v1 and public.can_manage_support conditions in canonical eligibility trigger.

challenge.scenario: A store owner tries assigning an outside-tenant user to an Office customer thread.
challenge.finding: A cross-tenant assignee might gain customer information.
challenge.resolution: Assert instance-bound store membership query and support RBAC; verify live tenant negative later.

challenge.scenario: A private participant calls leave, then immediately requests the same thread read.
challenge.finding: A stale membership path may continue permitting chat access after leave.
challenge.resolution: Require left_at mutation filtered by instance/thread/actor and 0050 active participant predicate in tests.

challenge.scenario: A nonparticipant or already-left user calls the leave RPC.
challenge.finding: Unaudited or misattributed exit could conceal attempted actor spoof.
challenge.resolution: Verify update WHERE left_at is null and explicit OFFICE_PRIVATE_PARTICIPANT_NOT_ACTIVE exception.

challenge.scenario: A client calls leave RPC with a customer rather than private/group thread.
challenge.finding: Customer support conversation could be modified by private chat feature.
challenge.resolution: Assert conversation_type in internal_private/internal_group and OFFICE_INTERNAL_THREAD_NOT_FOUND exception.

challenge.scenario: The service-role caller supplies another user UUID as p_actor.
challenge.finding: Postgres SECURITY DEFINER bypasses RLS and trusts supplied actor, potentially impersonating participant.
challenge.resolution: Do not treat static source PASS as RPC security proof; demand end-to-end server-session binding before DONE.

challenge.scenario: A migration excludes private audit insert despite successful left_at update.
challenge.finding: Participant exits become untraceable and capability closure is false.
challenge.resolution: Full canonical source hash and explicit admin_audit_log office.private_thread_left proof.

challenge.scenario: The baseline is marked ready after append-only 0051 without later helper hardening or Fresh Install.
challenge.finding: CI overclaims security/proof and makes incomplete Office schema appear deployable.
challenge.resolution: Keep snapshot-reviewed, null proof hash, and next 0052+ and runtime blockers explicit.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The 0050 Office participant privacy foundation in the staged customer baseline lacks its canonical follow-up 20260908023000 membership hardening. Customer thread assignments must reject inactive or unsupported employees; internal private-thread participants must be able to leave, immediately revoking read access while preserving auditable tenant boundaries. This is only a source migration, not a live role/tenant proof.
